headline: Nathan Fielder's new documentary centers on Theranos fraudster Elizabeth Holmes
summary: Comedian Nathan Fielder released a new documentary about disgraced Theranos CEO Elizabeth Holmes. Coverage framed much of the project's appeal around Fielder's own experimental comedic style, with one review describing it as exploring colliding personas that interrogate the nature of authenticity.
